summary: Create a rulebook activation with name, Default organization, project and rulebook; use the Event streams gear to replace the ansible.builtin.webhook source with your event stream and Save, add the AAP credential, choose a decision environment, and create it; repeat to attach the same stream to a second activation.
questions: How do I map a GitHub event stream to a rulebook source?
Can one event stream feed two rulebook activations?
Which credential lets an activation launch job templates?
